spp_cornet_gunner.text: Castle Cornet. In the Civil War we backed the king, and the rest of Guernsey backed Parliament. We sat out here for eight years, till the end of 1651, getting supplies by sea and shooting at the town. Awkward neighbours.
We fire the Noon Gun every day at midday. It's the loudest thing in St Peter Port. Visitors jump and locals check their watches. I can tell you the exact moment the starling flies off the roof.
